answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 54360 Country: India Title: SCHOLARSHIPS Question: Is it permissible to avail scholarships from the government for studies which are based on merit? Answer ID: 54360 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 29/29/SD=10/1435) Scholarship is a kind of reward given by the government. According to Shariah it is lawful to avail it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
